instances_username.name: instances_username
instances_username.value: ("instances"."auth_mode" = 'token' AND "instances"."username" IS NULL) OR ("instances"."auth_mode" = 'password' AND length("instances"."username") > 0 AND "instances"."username" IS NOT NULL)

instances_times.name: instances_times
instances_times.value: "instances"."created_at" >= 0 AND "instances"."updated_at" >= 0 AND ("instances"."archived_at" IS NULL OR "instances"."archived_at" >= 0) AND ("instances"."last_test_at" IS NULL OR "instances"."last_test_at" >= 0) AND ("instances"."auth_blocked_until" IS NULL OR "instances"."auth_blocked_until" >= 0)

job_targets_limits.name: job_targets_limits
job_targets_limits.value: ("job_targets"."delete_limits_enabled" = 0 OR "job_targets"."max_delete_count" IS NOT NULL OR "job_targets"."max_delete_percent" IS NOT NULL) AND ("job_targets"."max_delete_count" IS NULL OR "job_targets"."max_delete_count" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991) AND ("job_targets"."max_delete_percent" IS NULL OR "job_targets"."max_delete_percent" BETWEEN 0 AND 100)

jobs_booleans.name: jobs_booleans
jobs_booleans.value: "jobs"."enabled" IN (0,1) AND "jobs"."source_refresh" IN (0,1) AND "jobs"."allow_empty_source" IN (0,1) AND "jobs"."sync_empty_dirs" IN (0,1)

jobs_sizes.name: jobs_sizes
jobs_sizes.value: ("jobs"."min_size_bytes" IS NULL OR "jobs"."min_size_bytes" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991) AND ("jobs"."max_size_bytes" IS NULL OR "jobs"."max_size_bytes" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991) AND ("jobs"."min_size_bytes" IS NULL OR "jobs"."max_size_bytes" IS NULL OR "jobs"."min_size_bytes" <= "jobs"."max_size_bytes")

operations_run_clearable.name: operations_run_clearable
operations_run_clearable.where: "operations"."retry_of" IS NOT NULL OR "operations"."resolved_by_run_id" IS NOT NULL OR "operations"."reobserved_by_run_id" IS NOT NULL

operations_run_references.name: operations_run_references
operations_run_references.where: "operations"."retry_of" IS NOT NULL OR "operations"."caused_by_operation_id" IS NOT NULL OR "operations"."resolved_by_run_id" IS NOT NULL OR "operations"."reobserved_by_run_id" IS NOT NULL

operations_method.name: operations_method
operations_method.value: ("operations"."action" = 'mkdir' AND "operations"."method" = 'mkdir') OR ("operations"."action" = 'create' AND "operations"."method" IN ('relay','server_copy')) OR ("operations"."action" = 'delete' AND "operations"."method" = 'remove')

operations_sizes.name: operations_sizes
operations_sizes.value: "operations"."affected_file_count" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991 AND "operations"."affected_bytes" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991 AND "operations"."bytes_downloaded" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991 AND "operations"."bytes_transferred" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991 AND ("operations"."expected_source_size" IS NULL OR "operations"."expected_source_size" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991) AND ("operations"."expected_target_size" IS NULL OR "operations"."expected_target_size" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991)

operations_terminal.name: operations_terminal
operations_terminal.value: "operations"."status" NOT IN ('succeeded','failed','skipped','unknown','cancelled') OR "operations"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL

operations_unknown_fields.name: operations_unknown_fields
operations_unknown_fields.value: "operations"."status" != 'unknown' OR ("operations"."unknown_since" IS NOT NULL AND "operations"."unknown_until" IS NOT NULL AND "operations"."unknown_until" >= "operations"."unknown_since")

operations_resolution.name: operations_resolution
operations_resolution.value: "operations"."resolution_kind" IS NULL OR ("operations"."resolution_kind" IN ('observed','superseded','abandoned') AND "operations"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND ("operations"."resolution_kind" != 'abandoned' OR "operations"."resolution_note" IS NOT NULL))

operations_task_method.name: operations_task_method
operations_task_method.value: "operations"."method" = 'server_copy' OR ("operations"."openlist_task_id" IS NULL AND "operations"."remote_state" IS NULL)

operations_multipart_method.name: operations_multipart_method
operations_multipart_method.value: "operations"."method" = 'relay' OR ("operations"."multipart_upload_id" IS NULL AND "operations"."multipart_chunk_size" IS NULL AND "operations"."multipart_state" IS NULL AND "operations"."multipart_attempt" IS NULL AND "operations"."source_stream_completed_at" IS NULL)

operations_cause.name: operations_cause
operations_cause.value: ("operations"."caused_by_operation_id" IS NULL AND ("operations"."error_code" IS NULL OR "operations"."error_code" != 'REMOTE_TASK_CHANGED')) OR ("operations"."caused_by_operation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "operations"."error_code" = 'REMOTE_TASK_CHANGED' AND "operations"."openlist_task_id" IS NULL)

run_targets_booleans.name: run_targets_booleans
run_targets_booleans.value: "run_targets"."source_complete" IN (0,1) AND "run_targets"."target_complete" IN (0,1) AND "run_targets"."suspect" IN (0,1) AND "run_targets"."delete_blocked" IN (0,1) AND "run_targets"."extras_blocked" IN (0,1)

run_targets_counts.name: run_targets_counts
run_targets_counts.value: "run_targets"."observed_target_file_count" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991 AND "run_targets"."planned_replace_count" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991 AND "run_targets"."planned_extra_count" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991 AND ("run_targets"."delete_budget_count" IS NULL OR "run_targets"."delete_budget_count" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991)

runs_terminal.name: runs_terminal
runs_terminal.value: "runs"."status" NOT IN ('succeeded','partial','failed','cancelled','interrupted') OR "runs"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL

runs_times.name: runs_times
runs_times.value: "runs"."created_at" >= 0 AND "runs"."updated_at" >= 0 AND "runs"."queue_deadline_at" >= "runs"."created_at" AND ("runs"."started_at" IS NULL OR "runs"."started_at" >= 0) AND ("runs"."ended_at" IS NULL OR "runs"."ended_at" >= 0) AND ("runs"."deadline_at" IS NULL OR "runs"."deadline_at" >= 0)
